subject: Re: Urgent: Latency spike — exec needs timeline & logs
messages:
From: Sara Potter <sara.potter@northbridge.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ops@northbridge.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike tonight — need logs for exec review

Hi Rafael,

Heads up — our CTO is asking for an incident summary after a large latency spike last night that impacted checkout flows (11:38–11:52 PDT). We need the following for an executive briefing by EOD tomorrow:
- Timeline of events (ingress spikes, error-rate changes, fallbacks)
- Runtime logs and traces for the window (request IDs, model variants served)
- Assurance on log integrity (hashes/chain of custody) and access controls
- Any PII/PHI exposure and redaction steps taken

I've attached a short summary from our ops team (spike_summary.pdf). Please confirm what you can provide and an ETA. Our legal/sig-compliance folks may require a sealed evidence bundle for audit.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Potter
Incident Lead, Northbridge Payments
----
Attachment: spike_summary.pdf (2 pages PDF, customer ops summary)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Potter <sara.potter@northbridge.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike tonight — need logs for exec review

Sara — thanks for the flag and summary. I'm escalating to infra and security (cc'd) and proposing an evidence-handling plan so we can meet your EOD ask. High level:

1) Preservation: we will snapshot raw runtime logs for 11:30–11:55 PDT and lock them under an incident bucket. No automatic deletions during preservation.
2) Integrity: generate SHA256 checksums for the archive, sign with our evidence KMS key, and produce a chain-of-custody doc.
3) Scope: include request-level traces (request_id, route, model_variant, latency_ms, error_code), system-level telemetry (gpu utilization, queue depth), and routing/fallback events. We will avoid exporting unredacted prompt text unless explicitly requested and agreed by both legal teams.
4) Delivery: supply a sealed tarball + checksums and a read-only presigned S3 URL for your auditors.

Vanessa / Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm the technical steps and ETA to produce the bundle, plus any expected gaps (e.g., ephemeral KV cache artifacts that we cannot reproduce)? Also confirm who will own the chain-of-custody doc and whether we need a legal hold flag.

Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
----
Attachment: (none)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, sara.potter@northbridge.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike tonight — need logs for exec review

Adding detail from security/ops side. We will: 

- Snapshot: pull runtime logs (application + runtime trace) and system telemetry for 11:30–11:55 PDT. We will also pull service sidecar logs for routing policies.
- Storage & keying: place artifacts in s3://redwood-evidence/nb-payments/2028-06-12/; encrypt with customer-evidence KMS key (key-id: projects/redwood/kms/cust-evidence-nb-7842).
- Retention: standard runtime logs TTL is 90 days; for this incident we will set a preservation hold for 365 days unless legal requests otherwise.
- Integrity & COC: compute SHA256 checksums per file and sign the archive; produce a Chain-of-Custody PDF with timestamps and operator IDs. I will own the COC doc generation.
- Redaction: default export will mask full prompt text and any detected PII using our redaction pipeline; we can provide anonymized prompt snapshots (first/last 50 tokens) for quality checks. Any request for raw prompt text requires both legal approvals and a documented NDA amendment.

ETA: initial sealed bundle within 6 hours (target 17:30 PDT today). Full COC + signed checksums and presigned URL by EOD tomorrow.

Attachment: evidence_handling_checklist.pdf (internal checklist stub)

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike — extraction details and artifact contents

Technical note from runtime/infra:

- What we'll include in the bundle:
  * per_request_traces.jsonl (one JSONL row per request) with fields: request_id, timestamp, route, model_variant, latency_ms, error_code, server_instance, shard_id, fallback_flag
  * runtime_agent.log (rotated), scheduler_metrics.csv, gpu_metrics.csv
  * routing_decisions.json (sampled) and prefix-cache-events.log

- Important: KV-cache contents are ephemeral; we will capture KV cache event logs (hits/misses) and cache-pop trace records, but not full cache contents.
- Prompts: By default we will mask prompt tokens; if Northbridge requests anonymized prompts we will deliver redacted snapshots (first/last 50 tokens) with the per_request_traces rows referencing masked_prompt_id->snapshot file.
- Extraction script: we'll run the standard incident_extraction.sh that pulls files, packages them, computes checksums and uploads to the evidence bucket. I've attached the script stub name here (extraction_script.sh).

S3 path (internal): s3://redwood-evidence/nb-payments/2028-06-12/artifacts-v1.tar.gz
Presigned link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/nb-payments/2028-06-12/artifacts-v1.tar.gz?presigned=masked

ETA: archive ready ~17:20 PDT; COC and signed checksums by 06/13 EOD. If legal asks for raw prompts we need explicit approval and will document who requested and the retention changes.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

Rafael / team — thank you, this is helpful and on a good timeline. A few follow-ups from legal and our CTO: 

- Please include token-level counts (total tokens processed by affected tenant during spike) and anonymized prompt snapshots as you noted.
- Our SOC2 auditor also wants a sealed copy of the archive and the Chain-of-Custody; can you confirm that the presigned URL will be read-only and that we can request a notarized COC if needed?
- Executives want a one-page summary: cause hypothesis, mitigation applied (routing/fallback), customer impact, and next steps. Can someone on your team draft that?

If you can confirm the presigned link expiry and that redaction will be applied by default unless legal escalates, we can close this out for the exec meeting.

Best,
Sara Potter
